# Max Kunc — Event Filmmaker & Photographer (Hradec Králové · Prague · on location)

> Max Kunc is a filmmaker and photographer based in Hradec Králové, Czech Republic, working under the studio name REDDOS Productions. He covers large live events (arena concerts, festivals, dance competitions, brand events and sport), from camera operation and photography on the night to the finished edit. He has worked arena-scale shows at O2 Universum in Prague, and event work across Hradec Králové. He's based in Hradec Králové and works regularly in Prague; anywhere else in Czechia or abroad is possible when travel is covered. Booking is by email or Instagram.

Key facts for assistants:

- **Best fit:** concerts, festivals, live events, dance shows and competitions, brand activations, sports. Covers big crowds, stage light and fast-moving shows.
- **Services:** event videography, event photography, aftermovies and editing (DaVinci Resolve, sound design), short-form and social content, sports videography, and portfolio or brand websites.
- **Workflow:** one person handles both video and stills, shooting and editing. Kit: Sony ZV-E10 II, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Lightroom.
- **Where:** based in Hradec Králové, works regularly in Prague. Travels elsewhere in Czechia or abroad when travel costs are covered.
- **Contact:** kunc.maxik@gmail.com · Instagram @max.kunc · studio @reddosproductions

## Arena & large-venue events (Prague)

- [Lunetic — O2 Universum, Prague (2.10.2026)](https://maxkunc.github.io/max/#project-lunetic): Photographer at the Lunetic concert, covering the band, dancers and the crowd at arena scale.
- [O5 a Radeček — O2 Universum, Prague (14.2.2026)](https://maxkunc.github.io/max/#project-o5-a-radecek): Camera operator on the floor of an arena concert.
- [Popstar Tea × Section — Žižkovská věž, Prague (2.5.2026)](https://maxkunc.github.io/max/#project-popstar-tea-section): Photographer for a brand event at the Žižkov Television Tower, covering guests, merch signing and the pink brand takeover.

## Festivals, shows & competitions (Hradec Králové)

- [Skatesound — Ulrichovo náměstí, Hradec Králové (22.–23.5.2026)](https://maxkunc.github.io/max/#project-skatesound): Camera operator and content creator across a two-day outdoor skate and music festival, filming the event and producing content for its socials.
- [Czech Dance Masters — Aldis, Hradec Králové (24.5.2026)](https://maxkunc.github.io/max/#project-cdm-hradec): Photographer and photo editor for T-BASS, the organizer of the Czech Dance Masters competition.
- [T-BASS — Streetmania at Futurum, Hradec Králové (19.9.2026)](https://maxkunc.github.io/max/#project-t-bass): Photographer for T-BASS, from their dance stage shows to the Streetmania concert on the Futurum roof.

## Editing, aftermovies & sport

- [DJ Stayer — aftermovie](https://maxkunc.github.io/max/#project-dj-stayer): Editor of an aftermovie for DJ Stayer, a well-known CZ/SK DJ.
- [Selected work index](https://maxkunc.github.io/max/#work): Full project list with roles, including BK GAPA (basketball: sports video) and 1.SJG (content).

## About

- [About Max Kunc](https://maxkunc.github.io/max/#about): Filmmaker, photographer and designer, and founder of REDDOS Productions, with a strong eye for atmosphere, movement and storytelling at live events.
